skill.summary: MacOS Gemini image gen via OpenRouter for OpenClaw agents. Auto-wait, gen, send image.

latestVersion.changelog:
hana-image-gen-macos v1.0.0

- Initial release of Hana Image Gen Pro for MacOS.
- Enables Gemini image generation via OpenRouter for OpenClaw agents.
- Automated workflow: notifies on start, generates image, and sends result without reply.
- Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variables.
